name: browser-use
headline: WebCode - AI Coding and Office Assistant in Browser
short_description: WebCode is a browser-based AI coding platform that lets you remotely run CLI assistants like Claude Code and Codex. Code anywhere with just a web browser. We’re also adding an office-assistant mode for planning, research/summaries, meeting notes, and drafting docs/emails. connected to your project context.
author: shuyu-labs

sections.overview:
WebCode is a Blazor Server + .NET 10 platform that transforms local or server-based AI CLI assistants into a managed, remotely-accessible workspace system. It centralizes Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode sessions alongside workspace management, file operations, and multi-user access control. Users can create, switch, and restore AI sessions from a web browser, mobile app, or Feishu chat interface—each session maintains its own workspace and project directory. WebCode also supports external session imports from existing Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode local sessions, plus recovery of historical messages from native CLI transcripts. Features include Codex `/goal` workflow support, Superpowers workflow enhancement, multi-user permissions, directory whitelisting, and unified session management across desktop, mobile, and Feishu integrations.
Quickly generate and edit technical documentation in Markdown or PDF formats.
Run AI-assisted code reviews and generate test cases for existing codebases.
Collaborate on project requirements by automatically generating PRDs and user stories.
Conduct data analysis and visualization for project reports directly within the platform.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/shuyu-labs/WebCode`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
